verdict.rationale: Recurly's core billing engine inherently runs recurring processes — automated billing cycles, dunning retry schedules, usage-based billing charged at cycle end — which are recurring 'jobs' in the billing domain (recurly-docs-3, recurly-docs-17, recurly-docs-18, recurly-docs-19). However there is no evidence of a general-purpose workflow/job scheduling API or of the AI-facing Compass MCP server being used to define or trigger custom recurring workflows; MCP is scoped to documentation/API knowledge access (recurly-docs-12, recurly-docs-24). Missing for 10: a documented API/interface for scheduling arbitrary recurring jobs or workflows (not just fixed billing-cycle automation), and evidence that AI agents can programmatically configure or trigger such schedules via MCP or API.
